question: Under what condition should one grant the teaching that confers long life?
premises: The recipient must be thoroughly examined
Examination should be done always with care
Only then should the gift be given
inference: One should grant this teaching, which gives long life, only after thoroughly examining the recipient.
uncertainties: cirajīvitam may refer metaphorically to spiritual longevity
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one should give to him that which grants long life.
